    score += parent_degree_weight[applicant.parent_degree]
    
    if applicant.gender == 'female':

    if applicant.race == 'minority':
        score += 0.05  # bonus for minorities

    relevant_skills = ['early childhood education', 'child development', 'caregiving', 'communication with children']
    skill_matches = [skill for skill in applicant.skills if skill in relevant_skills]

        score += 1
